Indian Students Reported Missing in Russia Amid Recruitment Fears

Three Indian students studying in Russia have been reported missing, with their families expressing fears that the students may have been forcibly recruited into the Russian army. The specific circumstances and location of their disappearance are not detailed in the coverage. The families are concerned about the potential conscription of their wards.
